title: Linalool exposure in Listeria monocytogenes
limitations: Three samples per arm; FPKM is not count-based differential expression; gene annotation crosswalk needed

title: Tea tree oil and component exposure in Botrytis cinerea
limitations: Shared untreated control can inflate pairwise arm similarity; FPKM is not count-based differential expression

title: R-(+)-limonene exposure in Penicillium digitatum
assay: bulk RNA-seq; author-processed FPKM candidate table
evidence_class: published expression and annotation table; checksum-pinned notebook audit
limitations: Table S7 lacks per-gene adjusted p values and replicate measurements; expression direction is descriptive, not independently estimated DE or target evidence

title: Linalool exposure in Fusarium oxysporum
assay: bulk RNA-seq and proteomics; author-processed supplementary tables
evidence_class: published DEG and KEGG tables; checksum-pinned notebook audit
limitations: Published statistics were audited, not recomputed from raw reads; six-day growth inhibition and cross-kingdom exposure differences preclude replication or target claims

title: D-limonene exposure in Fusarium proliferatum
assay: bulk RNA-seq and ChIP-seq; author-processed supplementary tables
evidence_class: published DEG and acetylation-associated KEGG tables; checksum-pinned notebook audit
limitations: Published statistics were not re-estimated from raw reads; 200 mM for 24 h substantially inhibits growth, and a one-row up-count discrepancy remains unresolved

title: Terpinen-4-ol exposure in methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus
evidence_class: processed expression matrix; checksum-pinned descriptive audit
limitations: Three control and three treated libraries; FPKM ratios are pseudocount sensitive, not new differential-expression or pathway estimates; no cross-species replication or direct target test

title: Beta-caryophyllene exposure in HepG2
assay: bulk RNA-seq; processed fractional RSEM-style counts
evidence_class: processed count matrix; checksum-pinned descriptive audit
limitations: Three vehicle and three exposed libraries from one cell line; per-sample dose fields conflict with common protocol; fractional counts and pseudocount-sensitive ratios are not new DEGs, pathway activity, or direct target evidence
